subject: a small character folded from one thick ceramic slab
pose: one corner lifted like a raised eyebrow, feet planted unevenly
art_direction: 厚釉陶片折成方圆兼具的小精灵，单侧抬眉与不齐短腿赋予性格，梅紫釉和酸黄裂口相衬。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Fold a thick ceramic slab into a small freestanding character with a rounded-square body and two short unequal feet. One upper corner lifts like a raised eyebrow, while two shallow dark eye cuts and a tiny straight mouth remain carved into the surface. Use a deep plum glaze outside and acid-yellow glaze visible only inside the folded edge. Show slight glaze pooling and a few controlled kiln freckles, not damage or cracks. The stance is skeptical but friendly, with one foot forward. Place the figure on a pale gray background under broad studio light. Keep the entire shape centered, occupying roughly seventy percent of the square, with no props or text.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
